title: Cloud-market price evidence and freshness
summary: Azure public retail polling, read-only AWS Spot history and GCP component price catalogue are different observation classes. A Spot historical rate does not prove inventory; GCP CPU and RAM SKU components are not a complete VM. Twenty-three names in a provider registry are not twenty-three working observers.
invariants: Public tariff, historical transaction, capacity availability and provisionable quote are distinct facts.
Retain original source timestamp, provider/region/zone, billing unit, currency, payload fingerprint and retrieval outcome.
Expired, malformed, contradictory or missing observations fail closed.
Do not complete a missing CPU/RAM/storage/egress price by inserting zero.
Price observations cannot turn themselves into approved authority flags.

provenance.claim: Cloud Economics v0.1-dev8 source evidence; status=IMPLEMENTED.

procedure: Identify the exact API/source and whether an authenticated read-only principal is configured.
Normalize units without rounding away minimum charge or tier terms.
Store provenance and source freshness; preserve failures rather than replaying stale scratch deltas.
Assemble whole-job terms only after every required component is independently accounted for.
